method: Exact counts over judgment_citations and judgments on the live corpus. A row is a BLANK SENTINEL when relationship = 'cites' and citation_text is empty — it records that the extractor looked and found nothing, and it is not a citation. Coverage is defined on RESOLVED EDGES (cited_judgment_id IS NOT NULL) and on nothing else.
bannedClaim: 'Every judgment has its citations mapped' is arithmetically TRUE of row presence — every judgment has at least one judgment_citations row — and completely false in meaning, because 71.97% of those rows are the blank sentinel.
stalenessDirection: SAFE. NEW2's resolver only adds edges, so a figure measured here understates later coverage. An understated partiality declaration is conservative; declaring MORE coverage than exists is the failure that matters and monotonic growth makes it unreachable without a deletion.
crossCheck: Matches docs/product/V1_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_R12.json capability citation.graph_partial, measured independently by NEW3 on 2026-08-29: 22,406,483 / 16,127,190 / 6,279,293 / 227,517 / 200,761 / 105,024 / 35,153.
